title: vayadhammā saṅkhārā
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
“Then the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus thus: ‘Now I address you, bhikkhus:
conditioned things are of the nature to vanish;
strive without heedlessness to attain [the goal].’
This was the last statement of the Tathāgata.”
